description: Add a standing rule and hold this project to it (a design-system rule, a tone-of-voice rule, a compliance obligation, or shared knowledge). Every checklist run, design review, interview and triage for the project is then held to it. The rule joins the workspace library, so check list_workspace_guidelines first and attach an existing rule with `set_project_guideline` rather than adding a second copy.

category.description: What kind of rule this is: design_system, tone_of_voice, brand, content (labels, terminology, formatting), accessibility, compliance, security, performance, or knowledge (anything else an actor should know).

content.description: The rule itself, written so someone can observe whether the product holds to it, e.g. "Primary buttons use sentence case." Trimmed and capped at 4000 characters.

title.description: Short name for the rule, capped at 160 characters, e.g. "Sentence-case buttons". Derived from the leading words of content when omitted.

name: add_project_guideline

enabled.description: The library switch: false retires the rule everywhere.

id.description: Library guideline UUID, the guideline_id other tools take.

title: Add project guideline
